title: Junior Design Engineer
rationale:
Junior design role for roads, drainage, car parks and traffic calming in AutoCAD; strong coursework overlap.
Main Roads WA standards and a WA licence are gaps; Perth relocation.
Closes 30 September 2026.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast. Employer acceptance of a time-limited 485 visa and relocation are the main unknowns.
gaps: Whether a WA driver's licence/White Card can be arranged in time
Time available before the 30 Sep 2026 close date
apply_instructions: Applications must be submitted online from the Vincent jobs board and include a CV and cover letter, which outlines your suitability to the role.
notes: Closes 30 September 2026, only two days after this screening run.
